# Codebook: Delhey & Newton 2005

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, error = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sjlabelled)
library(easystats)
library(tinytable)

my_codebook <- function(df, show_ID = FALSE, show_type = TRUE, show_missing = TRUE) {

  # df <- delhey_newton_2005

  Levels <- c()
  for (i in names(df)) {
    Levels <- c(Levels, nlevels(as_factor(df[[i]])))
  }

  Range <- c()
  for (i in names(df)) {
    if (nlevels(as_factor(df[[i]])) > 1) {
      if (grepl("_nwords", i)) {
        Range <-  c(Range, paste0(first(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))), " : ", last(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))), " words"))
        } else 
          if (nlevels(as_factor(df[[i]])) == 2) {
            Range <-  c(Range, paste0(first(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))), " | ", last(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))) ) )
          } else 
            if (is.numeric(df[[i]]) & !grepl("_nwords", i)) {
              Range <-  c(Range, paste0(first(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))), " : ", last(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]])))))
              } else 
                Range <-  c(Range, paste0(first(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))), "\U22EF", last(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))) ) )
    } else 
      if (grepl("_nwords", i)) {
        if (Min(df[[i]])==1) {
          Range <- c(Range, paste(first(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))), "word"))
          } else Range <- c(Range, paste(first(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))), "words"))
        } else Range <- c(Range, first(get_labels(as_factor(df[[i]]))))
  }

  LevelsRange <- paste0(Levels, " (", Range, ")")

  df <- df |> 
      mutate(across(where(~ is.factor(.x) && nlevels(.x) > 9), 
                as_numeric)) |> 
    data_codebook() |> 
    filter(Name != "") |>
    rename(
      `N (%) missing` = Missings,
      Variable = Name
    ) |>
    mutate(Levels = LevelsRange)

  # codebook <- df |>

  #   select(1:5, 10)

  default_cols <- seq_len(min(5, ncol(df)))
  cols <- default_cols
  if (!show_ID)       cols <- setdiff(cols, 1)  # hide column 1
  if (!show_type)     cols <- setdiff(cols, 4)  # hide column 4
  if (!show_missing)  cols <- setdiff(cols, 5)  # hide column 5

  if (ncol(df) >= 10) cols <- unique(c(cols, 10))
  cols <- sort(intersect(cols, seq_len(ncol(df))))
  sel_names <- names(df)[cols]

  codebook <- df |> select(all_of(sel_names))
}

delhey_newton_2005 <- data_read("Data/workshop_data/w3/delhey_newton_2005.rds")

my_codebook(delhey_newton_2005) |> tinytable::tt() |> 
  style_tt(fontsize = 0.8) |> 
  style_tt(j = 1, bold = TRUE)
```
